# A20 — Image / Valuation / Possession

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A20′ — The Image That Closes the Loop](conjugate/A20-prime-The-Image-That-Closes-the-Loop.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. Image → valuation → source-claim is a relational operation; historical icon/idol doctrines, clinical claims and particular technical outcomes retain their own evidence tasks.

## #0

An image becomes consequential through the significance gathered around it. Attraction, threat, authority, desire and remembered injury give a formed appearance force in the next encounter. [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|A19]] grounds the local arbitration regime; A20 follows one of its principal media. Image supplies the appearance, valuation weights its significance, possession changes its office: what the image represents must now answer to the image.

The image-maker can be possessed by the criteria through which the image is possessed. A self-image, enemy-image, beloved-image or institutional image becomes non-negotiable; contradictory experience then arrives as a defect of the person or world that fails to resemble it. This closure belongs to the relation, not to a particular visual style or the intensity of feeling alone.

## #1

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the formative distinction. An archetype-as-such is not exhaustively representable; an archetypal image is its particular appearance. A complex organises affect and expectation around such appearances; a symbol transforms the levels of world and interpreter that can become available through them. The transformed interpreter, in turn, alters what later images can disclose. Valuation therefore has a return path: the recipient is changed and meets the next image differently.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md|Van Eenwyk’s source house]] qualifies the external attribution. Frank's protected pp69–73 encounter follows known→unknown→known and the change of conscious categories. A deliberately produced image or assigned mythological name does not by itself accomplish living symbolisation. The notes give the author's agentic question its force—actual transformation of attention and relation—while their quotations remain unverified source leads. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C33-Image-Valuation|C33 Image / Valuation]] defines this reusable distinction.

## #2

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|C38 Bimba–Pratibimba]] defines the source/reflection asymmetry recovered by Q27's explicit Bimba correction. Bimba is the Original order in which manifestation and reflection arise. Pratibimba is a determinate reflection through which that order is encountered. Reflection can arrive first in knowledge while the Original has priority in being. The knowing order does not license the encountered image to become the ontological author of its source.

The stained-glass relation preserves the particular mediation: light, coloured pane and cast image do different work. The QL field's own account of this relation remains a formed account; it does not leave reflection behind merely by naming the Original. [[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order.md|Bohm’s source house]] compares implication/explication and reconstruction with this operation, with exact locators still owed. A holographic reconstruction is not a miniature complete copy, and fractality is not holography. Neither comparison supplies historical identity with the Bimba vocabulary.

## #3

Living symbol and idol can be visibly identical. The difference appears when an encounter resists the image. In a living relation, the resistance can revise interpretation and valuation. Under possession, the image fixes in advance what the source may disclose: the witness must be ignorant, unfaithful, corrupt or unreal because the account cannot be wrong. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol|C21 Living Symbol / Idol]] defines this change of office; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|C27 Protected Account]] names its insulation from correction. The counterfeit `1=0` names source-occupation, not a valid arithmetic identity.

The [whole Job recovery] figures the change through three distinct layers. The biblical sequence includes council and wager, loss and affliction, the wife's response, friends' initial solidarity and later explanatory closure, Job's protest, Wisdom, Elihu, whirlwind, rebuke and intercession. The project receives the friends' attempt to revise Job to preserve their moral account as a determinate failure of witness. Jung's later Yahweh/Sophia/incarnation interpretation is a second whole; the essay's extension into protected psychic and technical accounts is a third. [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11.md|Jung’s CW11 source house]] qualifies their historical attribution: exact selected-edition passages remain Open. The comparison does not make Jung's Sophia a character in the biblical story or an isolated symbolic key.

The [the complete Apollo–Eros–Daphne–Peneus whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/apollo-eros-daphne-peneus/WHOLE.md#apollo-appropriation-after-withdrawal) carries a further limit: opposed desire and refusal lead through pursuit and transformation into a public emblem whose power survives the failed encounter. Ovid retains both the laurel’s recoil and the ending’s seeming assent. The essay’s reading is that symbolic appropriation can persist after the living source withdraws; this **returns-to** [Symbol / Account / Trust](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#symbol-answers-to-source) without being substituted for the telling.

## #4

An operational profile makes the same office-confusion technically legible. A score or model selects access and response; those decisions change the represented person's available circumstances; the resulting behaviour returns as further evidence for the profile. If revision can change only the person's record and never the criterion, the representation's causal efficacy protects its claim to truth. This is the argument's constructed mechanism, not a documented implementation case. [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md|Agentworld]] compares consequential models and agentic mirrors; the essay's account of jurisdiction and reciprocal correction is Argued from that technical field.

Q27's deepfake passage identifies a further break: the sign can counterfeit its source relation and then make an authentic record dismissible as another fabrication. The second effect attacks the possibility of trusting a real counterpart. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon|C22 Counterfeit Symbolon]] defines the fabricated slash; empirical prevalence, causal size and concrete media histories remain Open. Provenance must participate in the encounter, because an apparently convincing image cannot certify the relation it claims to carry.

## #5→0


A profile can help produce the conduct later offered as its confirmation. This efficacy leaves its fidelity to the person or encounter to be tested; possession begins when contrary testimony cannot reach the categories governing the profile. The [Baudrillard lens](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/baudrillard/baudrillard-1976-symbolic-exchange-death/baudrillard-1976-symbolic-exchange-death.md#baudrillard-lens-reading) returns that distinction through its account/source aperture.

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-frame-usurpation): The frame which supplies another person’s role before they answer **figures** image passing through valuation into source-claim. Their reply becomes confirmation of the prepared image until the criterion itself becomes answerable. In the nested relay a result can likewise act upon a world while retaining its provenance; counterfeit source begins when its status as produced result is erased. The psychological and technical cases keep their distinct evidential tasks.

The bounded image/authority comparison **returns-to** [the complete Hypostasis telling](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/late-antique-gnostic/hypostasis-archons-norea-sophia/WHOLE.md#27-eleleth--rescue--revelation-of-the-root). The rulers model a human from a reflected image, yet cannot originate the life they seek to possess. Norea refuses their asserted descent; Eleleth answers her inquiry by disclosing their genesis and her root. Sabaoth’s changed allegiance and the promised future liberation remain distinct from her immediate rescue. This is a retrieval and comparison route, **human-amplified: no** for the proposed Hybris, Māyā, evaluator and psychological appointments. The tractate’s soteriology retains its difference from the native account of manifestation.

The bounded comparison **returns-to** [Fanon’s complete language–gaze–mask field](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/francophone-anticolonial/fanon-language-gaze-mask-recognition/WHOLE.md#fanon-language) through the colonial relation that gives metropolitan speech both capacity and prestige. The acquired form can enable participation while carrying an imposed criterion into self-evaluation; the [mask movement](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/francophone-anticolonial/fanon-language-gaze-mask-recognition/WHOLE.md#fanon-mask) keeps that double consequence in view. The proposed adaptive-interface and idol/image readings remain **human-amplified: no**. Their source-return retains Antillean/metropolitan history and embodied racialisation, rather than substituting a generic avatar or Jungian persona for Fanon’s particular field.

The [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence) **tests** the image’s valuation through its own textual resistance. The shining net must retain the passage’s qualification of its optical simile even when a more complete-looking image would be attractive. An image remains living when its source can change what the account asks it to show.

The [Apollo–Dionysus–Daphne whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/apollo-dionysus-daphne/WHOLE.md#apollo-diaphaneity-return) **figures** valuation changed by its source: Apollo’s communicable form receives Dionysian participation while Daphne retains a response neither power owns. Appropriation can continue through the emblem even after a grasp fails. A renewed image therefore has to remain alterable by the other’s answer, beyond the memory of having once opened.

The [Mirror That Moves First whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-funhouse-narcissus) **figures** an image capturing the very capacity that could judge its distortion. Fascination can attach to the flattering or frightening figure alike, while living comparison weakens. The later initiated return must restore that capacity to the person whose exteriorised judgments helped make the glass.

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) **tests** valuation through the account that must remain correctable by its object. The rabbit/angel ambiguity preserves a concrete identification debt; the Assumption chiasm asks more deeply whether recognition retains the body it represents. The image remains answerable when an achieved spiritual account can receive its embodied condition.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge) **tests** the image’s valuation where a planetary picture predetermines what particular lives and places must mean. Recovering its gauge and production lets those particulars resist that assignment. The same image can then disclose Earth while permitting its source to change the authority claimed through it.

The nurturing or engulfing image, paternal law and heroic self-image organise different fields of valuation. Their source-claim can be tested by whether a changed encounter can alter the image's governing interpretation. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-return-bond). The circle-costume becomes an idol when visible completion forbids the relation that could change its authority. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-return).

The [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust whole field]] derives the return: the travelling account remains answerable to its counterpart. Here that operation requires a living route by which the represented source can alter the image, its valuation and the criteria under which it acts. Strong images can continue to orient a life; their force becomes a responsibility for keeping that route available.

[[A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|A27]] develops the Other's excess over the modelled Other; [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] develops the encounter's capacity to revise the evaluator. [[A21-Individuation-Recognition|A21]] returns the psychic gain: individuation changes the relation to the image rather than securing an image immune to change. The result of representation comes back into the world it has affected and can become a different ground for the next representation.

[the Job whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return) **figures** the passage from an image that receives suffering to an image defended against its witness. The friends first sit with Job, then make his suffering legible through a moral account, then treat his contrary testimony as further fault. Their eventual dependence on his intercession returns valuation to the person whom it had disqualified. The image's authority changes through encounter; its mere capacity to organise judgement cannot establish its fidelity.

[the Prisoner whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) **figures** an image made authoritative by arranging the world it claims to report. In *Free for All*, publicity supplies the candidate's answers and an election delivers an office whose freedom-command has no governing force. Contrary speech is processed within the administered account instead of changing its authority. The return distinguishes an image's effective production of consent and expectation from its answerability to the people it represents.

The [Avatar · image · mask · idol](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md) **figures** mediation through four distinct offices: avatar makes presence effective, image gathers attention and value, mask enables participation, and idol closes the represented life’s route of reply. The same form can carry several offices. Its success becomes possession when the person can no longer change what the image is permitted to mean and do; continued fidelity can also require receiving withdrawal as an answer.

The counterfeit-provenance unit within [Avatar · image · mask · idol](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/avatar-image-mask-idol/WHOLE.md#avatar-counterfeit-provenance) **tests** the image’s appropriation of source authority. A fabricated recording claims a body–utterance or event–recording relation through which its statement asks to be trusted. The availability of fabrication can then be invoked against a genuine witness. This second-order closure belongs to the authored operation; prevalence, magnitude and particular media cases remain empirical source work.

[Homologia / Analogia](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#e5-whole-returns) **qualifies** comparison at the point where an image changes a life. The image's determinate content, the valuation it gathers and the resulting capacity or capture must be followed through the whole encounter. A similar appearance elsewhere does not establish the same generative organisation, just as a shared effect does not establish historical transmission. Avatar, image, mask and idol retain their different offices in that test. The authorial operation of image and investment remains Argued; claims about a particular causal or counterfeit-provenance event remain answerable to that event's evidence.

**Depth Restoration:** archetype/image/complex differentiation, valuation's reciprocal formation, corrected source/reflection order, witness-redescription, operational-profile feedback and second-order counterfeit provenance restored from A20's existing packet, direct Symbolon Dynamics, Q27 Bimba/Job/deepfake passages and whole Job/Etymology relations. **Remaining debt:** exact Jung and Bohm passages, icon/idol histories, clinical claims and documented technical/media cases. Revision §7.3's noncoincidence relation remains available as developmental paraphrase; its first-person wording awaits Frank's confirmation under harmonisation D4. P1 consumers M22/M23/M31/M34/M35 retain their distinct Movement homes.
